description: Official PlayCanvas documentation covering the Editor, the Engine, Web Components, React, SuperSplat and SplatTransform: scenes, assets, scripting, physics, graphics, UI and XR.
rules: PlayCanvas has four authoring surfaces: the browser-based Editor, the Engine API from npm or a CDN, @playcanvas/react and @playcanvas/web-components. Confirm which one applies before answering.
This manual covers concepts, workflows and Editor UI. For engine class, method and property signatures use the API reference at https://api.playcanvas.com.
PlayCanvas is right-handed with +Y up and forward along -Z. Rotations in the Editor, in React props and in Web Component attributes are Euler angles in degrees; distances are in meters.
